Target of the crosswalk of grid squares to municipalities

Source: R/grid-city-target.R
grid_city_target.Rd

grid_city_target() and grid_city_target_raw() declare a target of a 'targets' pipeline whose value is grid_city_get(date, grid_size). The target is rerun when the arguments, the URLs of the files of the release, or the installed version of locationchoicedatajp change.

Usage

grid_city_target(name, date, grid_size = "500m", ...)

grid_city_target_raw(name, date, grid_size = "500m", ...)

Arguments

name

Name of the target: a symbol for grid_city_target(), a string for grid_city_target_raw().

date

The date of the boundaries: a Date or a string such as "2020-10-01". The release in force on that date is used, which is the latest release with boundary_date on or before it. Use the reference date of the table to link, for example October 1 for the Population Census and January 1 for 地価公示. See grid_city_files() for the releases.

grid_size

The size of the grid squares: one of grid_sizes(), "500m" by default. Each size is built and cached for a release on its first call, without rebuilding the others.

...

Other arguments passed to targets::tar_target_raw().

Value

A target object.

Examples

grid_city_target(grid_city_2020, "2020-10-01")
#> <tar_stem> 
#>   name: grid_city_2020 
#>   description:  
#>   command:
#>     locationchoicedatajp::grid_city_get(date = "2020-10-01", grid_size = "500m")
#>     https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp/ksj/gml/data/N03/N03-2020/N03-20200101_01_GML.zip
